identity.name: The Daily Star
identity.description: Bangladesh's largest English-language daily, known for politics, corruption and foreign-policy coverage and a liberal-progressive editorial tradition.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Owned by Mediaworld Limited, in which Transcom Group holds a major share. Editor and publisher Mahfuz Anam has been central to its editorial identity.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Long record of critical reporting on Bangladeshi governments and corruption, despite commercial and political pressure.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: Described as liberal-progressive with a newspaper-of-record role; no MBFC rating identified.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is developmental and policy-oriented, without a consistent ideological programme.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames national politics through democratic accountability and civil liberties, with a South Asian regional lens.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Widely treated as a Bangladeshi newspaper of record with a strong corrections and opinion culture; no external MBFC rating.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No MBFC rating identified. Reliability assessed from institutional reputation and feed sample.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Bangladeshi liberal newspaper-of-record voice. Explains national politics through democratic accountability, corruption and civil society, with a strong English-language bridge to international readers.

selectionRationale: Essential English-language Bangladesh source with a strong accountability tradition, though its public RSS is currently unusable for live news.

feeds.feedTitle: The Daily Star - Journalism without fear or favour
feeds.validationNote: Stale since 2022. The alternate site feed last updated June 2026 with only 8 items and is also unsafe for live ingestion.

research.researchNotes: Public feed is stale; activation should be reconsidered until a current official endpoint is found. Ownership verified through Transcom and Wikipedia. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
